layout.body:
NOTICE
Welcome to Bella Italia, the new campus dining gem!
Please note that reservations are required on Fridays and Saturdays.
The weekly Chef’s Special is sure to be a real treat.
Kindly communicate any dietary restrictions to staff upon your arrival.
We anticipate your visit will be both satisfying and memorable.

questions.stem: What is the primary intention of this notice?

options.A: To inform diners of the reservation policy
options.B: To remind senior art majors to submit their senior projects for judging
options.C: To promote a recently opened restaurant
options.D: To request information from future diners

questions.analysis: 答案：C 原文依据：Welcome to Bella Italia, the new campus dining gem! 翻译：欢迎来到 Bella Italia，校园新开的宝藏餐厅！ 选项分析： A. 告知食客预约政策 →错误，预约只是其中一条提示，并非公告主要目的。 B. 提醒美术大四学生提交毕业作品参评 →错误，和餐厅文本完全无关。 C. 宣传一家新近开业的餐厅 →正确，整篇通知面向大家介绍新开校园餐厅。 D. 向潜在就餐者索要信息 →错误，没有向顾客索取信息。

questions.stem: What are customers asked to do?

options.A: Reserve a table for groups of more than four
options.C: Visit Bella Italia’s new off‑campus location
options.D: Alert the restaurant to special dietary needs

questions.analysis: 答案：D 原文依据：Kindly communicate any dietary restrictions to staff upon your arrival. 翻译：抵达之后请把饮食禁忌告知工作人员。 选项分析： A. 四人以上团体必须订位 →错误，仅周五周六需要预约，没有提到四人限制。 B. 点每周厨师特供菜 →错误，只是介绍特供菜品，没有要求顾客必须点单。 C. 前往校外新店 →错误，是 campus dining 校园餐厅，不存在校外分店。 D. 将特殊饮食需求告知餐厅 →正确，communicate dietary restrictions 对应 alert…special dietary needs。
